# Fire & Wok

> Authentic Chinese restaurant and takeaway in the heart of Peterborough city centre at 36 Cowgate, PE1 1NA. Dine-in, collection and delivery, open daily 12:00–22:00.

Fire & Wok specialises in wok-fired Cantonese and Szechuan cuisine — aromatic crispy duck, salt & pepper dishes, hand-tossed chow mein and a 3-course signature set menu (£31 per person, minimum 2 people). Reservations via TheFork; delivery and collection orders via the online ordering portal.

## Visit & Contact
- Address: 36 Cowgate, Peterborough, Cambridgeshire PE1 1NA, United Kingdom
- Phone: +44 1733 813001
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 12:00–22:00
- Cuisines: Chinese, Cantonese, Szechuan
- Price range: ££
- Payment: Cash, debit/credit card, contactless
- Reservations: Yes, walk-ins welcome
- Service: Dine-in, collection, delivery

## Signature Dishes
- Aromatic Crispy Duck (quarter £14.50, half £26.50) with pancakes, scallion, cucumber, hoisin
- Fire & Wok Special Chow Mein (£10.00)
- Salt & Pepper King Prawns (£12.50)
- Sweet & Sour Harmony Chicken (£9.50)
- Szechuan Spice Chicken / Beef (£9.50 / £10.50)
- Mapo Tofu, vegan (£9.50)
